newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BOAVISTA CUP WIN CLOSES BENFICA'S POOR SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOAVISTA CUP WIN CLOSES BENFICA'S POOR SEASON.

text.p: Two goals from Bolivian Edwin Sanchez helped Boavista to a hard-fought 3-2 victory over Benfica in the Portuguese Cup final on Tuesday.
Sanchez opened the scoring in the seventh minute with a wickedly struck free-kick and hit the northern side's third from a penalty in the 58th.
Defeat completed a miserable season for cup holders Benfica, who finished third in the league, well behind champions Porto and traditional Lisbon rivals Sporting.

Benfica defender Jose Calado scored his club's first in the 34rd minute and their second arrived in the second half when a fierce shot by Moroccan defender El Hadrioui took a deflection and beat Ricardo Pereira in the Boavista goal.
Benfica-bound Boavista striker Nuno Gomes should have made the game safe in the 75th minute but he pushed the ball wide with the goal at his mercy.
It was Boavista's fifth Portuguese Cup success after an indifferent league season in the league.
